title: ASSEMBLY OF STEERING GEAR HOUSING
ocr_text:
SR-84

STEERING — Power Steering (Gear Housing)

ASSEMBLY OF STEERING GEAR HOUSING
(See page SR-76)

1. COAT POWER STEERING FLUID OR GREASE ON FOLLOWING PARTS:

[Diagram showing exploded view of steering gear housing parts]

Molybdenum disulphide lithium base grease
Power steering fluid

2. INSTALL CYLINDER HOUSING OIL SEAL AND SPACER
(a) Coat a new oil seal lip with power steering fluid.
(b) Insert SST into the oil seal and spacer.
SST 09631-12020, 09631-32010
(c) Tap in the spacer and oil seal softly.

[Diagram showing SST installation with two views]

3. INSTALL RACK
(a) Install SST to the rack.
HINT: If necessary, scrape the burrs off the rack teeth end and burnish.
SST 09631-20102

[Diagram showing rack installation]
